name: notice
title: Notice
description: Inline message: a tone cell with a glyph, the message, and action cells; folds away; narrow layout drops actions to their own row.
whenToUse: Use it for an inline message about something that is still true where it sits, such as a warning on a form. For something that just happened use Toast.

parts.name: Notice
parts.description: An inline message about the place it sits in. One frame: a signal cell carrying the tone's glyph (shape, not only colour), the message, and its actions as cells. It never floats: a toast is a record of something that happened; a notice describes a condition that is still true. The frame (data-slot="notice") takes the props; it sits in a fold (data-slot="notice-root") that `open` unfolds from the top keyline.

props.description: Actions: Buttons with layout="cell". They share the notice's keylines and wrap below on narrow widths.

props.name: layout
props.description: control: its own 2px frame. cell: a row of an enclosing frame (top of a panel, above a table).

props.name: live
props.description: Announce when it appears. Use for results of something the user just did, not for page furniture.

props.name: open
props.description: false folds the notice back to its top keyline (and makes it inert); true unfolds it.
